title: Every man has one of
these 7 face shapes
hook: Every man has one of these seven face shapes. Here's how to spot yours.

baseFace.label: AI MODEL
baseFace.prompt: Photorealistic passport-style studio portrait of a fictional 25-year-old man (not a real person), square jaw, short dark wavy hair, neutral expression, looking straight at camera, face perfectly centered and frontal, head and shoulders, charcoal suit, white shirt, dark tie, plain flat dusty-sage green background, soft even frontal lighting, sharp focus, vertical 9:16, face occupies middle of frame with space above head

shapes.name: Oval
shapes.line: Oval. Slightly longer than wide, with a softly rounded jaw. The most balanced shape.

shapes.name: Oblong
shapes.line: Oblong. Long and narrow, with the forehead, cheeks and jaw all about the same width.

shapes.name: Round
shapes.line: Round. Almost as wide as it is long, with full cheeks and a soft chin.

shapes.name: Heart
shapes.line: Heart. A wide forehead that tapers down to a narrow, pointed chin.

shapes.name: Diamond
shapes.line: Diamond. The cheekbones are the widest point, with a narrow forehead and chin.

shapes.name: Triangle
shapes.line: Triangle. A narrow forehead sitting on top of a wide, heavy jaw.

shapes.name: Square
shapes.line: And square. Straight sides and sharp jaw corners. That's this guy's real shape.

cta: So which one are you? Drop your face shape in the comments.
